senses.definition: n.m. Ex 26:19 base, pedestal—אָדֶ֑ן Ex 38:27; pl. אֲדָנִים Ex 26:19 +; cstr. אַדְנֵי Ct 5:15 +, etc.
pedestals of fine gold, on wh. pillars of marble were set Ct 5:15.
pedestals of the earth on wh. its pillars were placed Jb 38:6 (‖ corner-stone).

(metal) pedestals, bases, or sockets in wh. tenons of planks & pillars of tabernacle were set up; two for each plank & one for each pillar Ex 26:19(×3) + 52 textual in Ex 26.27.35–40 Nu 3.4 (all P); cf. 𝔊 Sm Co for אָרְכּוֹ Ez 41:22, of altar.
